requirement: The system shall allow users to register and sign in using an email address and password, save registered users' account information, verify their credentials during sign-in, and navigate between the sign-up and sign-in views.
The system shall retrieve the text content corresponding to a list of titles, assemble the results in title order, and display an error indication to the user if content retrieval fails.
The system shall display the application's available scene content to users in the browser.

The system shall be deployed as a client-server web application with a browser client, a Node.js/Express-style web server, a relational database, a cache, and an external image storage service, and it shall keep application data and image/photo storage within those respective infrastructure boundaries.
